meta.note: Published values merged from the research brief (Furtwängler et al. 1906, archive.org OCR; printed page numbers). Entries still marked provisional are seed estimates. Scan values are merged by Step 2 merge_dimensions.py.

stylobateLength.definition: Upper step (stylobate top), length E-W, outer edge to outer edge.
stylobateLength.note: Printed "rund 28.80" (rounded) in the p. 52 table (87.7 Dörpfeld feet). Web summaries giving 28.50 or 28.81 are not used.

stylobateWidth.definition: Upper step (stylobate top), width N-S, outer edge to outer edge.
stylobateWidth.note: Printed "rund 13.80" (rounded) in the p. 52 table (42.0 Dörpfeld feet).

lowestStepLength.definition: Lowest crepidoma step, length E-W, outer edge to outer edge.

lowestStepWidth.definition: Lowest crepidoma step, width N-S, outer edge to outer edge.

interaxialFront.definition: Normal (non-corner) column axis spacing on the fronts.

interaxialFlank.definition: Normal (non-corner) column axis spacing on the flanks.
interaxialFlank.note: Conflict: the p. 52 table prints 2.56. Two text statements (pp. 24, 55) give 2.57, which is used.

cornerContractionFront.definition: Measured corner contraction on the east front: normal front interaxial minus the corner interaxial.
cornerContractionFront.note: Conflict: p. 55 prints a garbled "21½ cm" for the short fronts; the measured p. 29 value is used.

cornerContractionFlank.definition: Measured corner contraction on the south flank: normal flank interaxial minus the corner interaxial.
cornerContractionFlank.note: Conflict: p. 55 prints 0.26 for the long sides; the measured p. 29 value is used.

columnHeight.definition: Peristyle column height (Säulenhöhe) as tabulated; taken as stylobate top to abacus top.
columnHeight.note: The source gives column height = 2 × axial spacing = 16 Dörpfeld feet (p. 53). Its exact measuring points are not stated in the brief.

lowerDiameter.definition: Peristyle lower column diameter as printed.
lowerDiameter.note: The source does not say whether 0.99 is measured at the arrises or at the flute bottoms. Do not label it "at the arrises".

upperDiameter.definition: Peristyle upper column diameter as printed (below the necking).
upperDiameter.note: p. 27: the shaft tapers by about 1/4 of the lower diameter (0.99 × 0.75 = 0.74), consistent with 0.73.

fluteCount.definition: Flutes per peristyle column: shallow segmental ("flachbogig"), with three deep neck rings below the capital.
fluteCount.note: Not 24, as some popular summaries say.

echinusHeight.definition: Echinus height, necking/annulets top to abacus underside.
echinusHeight.note: PROVISIONAL seed estimate; not found in the research brief (Furtwängler 1906 text read via archive.org OCR, plates not seen). Replace when a source or the scan supplies it.

abacusHeight.note: PROVISIONAL seed estimate; not found in the research brief (Furtwängler 1906 text read via archive.org OCR, plates not seen). Replace when a source or the scan supplies it.

abacusWidth.note: PROVISIONAL seed estimate; not found in the research brief (Furtwängler 1906 text read via archive.org OCR, plates not seen). Replace when a source or the scan supplies it.

entablatureHeight.note: Unresolved: the source does not say whether the corona is included, and p. 53 gives "entablature without corona = 1/3 column height" (about 1.76 m). The two do not reconcile.

architraveHeight.definition: Architrave height including taenia (taenia itself 0.085 m, p. 28).
architraveHeight.note: Not given as a number in the text read. Split chosen so architrave + frieze + cornice = entablatureHeight. PROVISIONAL seed estimate; not found in the research brief (Furtwängler 1906 text read via archive.org OCR, plates not seen). Replace when a source or the scan supplies it.

friezeHeight.definition: Triglyph frieze height (triglyph head band 0.11 m, p. 28).
friezeHeight.note: Not given as a number in the text read. Split chosen so architrave + frieze + cornice = entablatureHeight. PROVISIONAL seed estimate; not found in the research brief (Furtwängler 1906 text read via archive.org OCR, plates not seen). Replace when a source or the scan supplies it.

corniceHeight.definition: Horizontal (geison) cornice height including mutule soffit.
corniceHeight.note: Not given as a number in the text read. Split chosen so architrave + frieze + cornice = entablatureHeight. PROVISIONAL seed estimate; not found in the research brief (Furtwängler 1906 text read via archive.org OCR, plates not seen). Replace when a source or the scan supplies it.

crepidomaStepCount.definition: Number of crepidoma steps including the stylobate course ("dreistufiger Stylobat").

crepidomaStepRise.note: PROVISIONAL seed estimate; not found in the research brief (Furtwängler 1906 text read via archive.org OCR, plates not seen). Replace when a source or the scan supplies it.

pedimentPitch.note: Furtwängler p. 143 prints "1:4 beim neuen Tempel" but does not say whether that is rise:run or rise:span; 1:4 rise:run is about 14.0°. Needs a plate or Bankel. PROVISIONAL seed estimate; not found in the research brief (Furtwängler 1906 text read via archive.org OCR, plates not seen). Replace when a source or the scan supplies it.

peristasisDepthEast.definition: East peristasis depth, from the inner edges of the stylobate slabs to the cella wall base.

peristasisDepthWestFlank.definition: West and flank peristasis depth, from the inner edges of the stylobate slabs to the cella wall base.

cellaOuterLength.definition: Naos (cella building incl. pronaos and opisthodomos) length without its step, E-W.

cellaOuterWidth.definition: Naos (cella building) width without its step, N-S.

cellaWallThickness.note: Printed as a range 0.78-0.816; the midpoint is stored, with the half-range as uncertainty. Cross walls are 0.89. The brief gives pp. 32, 33, 37 for the cella-wall details as a group.

antaWidth.note: PROVISIONAL seed estimate; not found in the research brief (Furtwängler 1906 text read via archive.org OCR, plates not seen). Replace when a source or the scan supplies it.

antaProjection.definition: Outward projection of the antae (49.9 cm).
antaProjection.note: The brief gives pp. 32, 33, 37 for the cella-wall details as a group.

doorWidth.definition: Cella east door clear width at the threshold.
doorWidth.note: PROVISIONAL seed estimate; not found in the research brief (Furtwängler 1906 text read via archive.org OCR, plates not seen). Replace when a source or the scan supplies it.

doorThresholdRise.definition: Height of the cella door threshold step.
doorThresholdRise.note: The door opening height is uncertain in the source.

pronaosColumnsInAntis.definition: Columns between the antae in the pronaos (east); the opisthodomos (west) matches.

pronaosLowerDiameter.definition: Lower diameter of the pronaos (in antis) columns.

pronaosStepRise.definition: Total rise of the double step under the pronaos columns.
pronaosStepRise.note: Printed as a 0.23 m double step; the split between the two steps is not given.

interiorColumnsPerSide.definition: Interior colonnade columns per side, in each of two storeys (two colonnades of five).

interiorAxialSpacing.definition: Axis spacing of the interior colonnade columns.

interiorCentreAisleWidth.definition: Width of the cella centre aisle between the interior step edges.

interiorLowerColumnHeight.definition: Interior lower-storey column height, cella floor to abacus top.
interiorLowerColumnHeight.note: PROVISIONAL seed estimate; not found in the research brief (Furtwängler 1906 text read via archive.org OCR, plates not seen). Replace when a source or the scan supplies it.

interiorLowerDiameter.note: PROVISIONAL seed estimate; not found in the research brief (Furtwängler 1906 text read via archive.org OCR, plates not seen). Replace when a source or the scan supplies it.

interiorUpperColumnHeight.note: The source calls the upper-column height only "ziemlich bestimmt" from Haller's measurements. PROVISIONAL seed estimate; not found in the research brief (Furtwängler 1906 text read via archive.org OCR, plates not seen). Replace when a source or the scan supplies it.

interiorUpperDiameter.note: PROVISIONAL seed estimate; not found in the research brief (Furtwängler 1906 text read via archive.org OCR, plates not seen). Replace when a source or the scan supplies it.

eastRampSlope.definition: East ramp slope, rise:run as printed ("1:6").
eastRampSlope.note: Read in section "II. 1. Der Altar" (page not pinned, near printed p. 69). Ramp existence: p. 25. It reaches the second step; a half-step bridged to the top step.
